materials.analysis: Given the moderate-risk profile of the investor, it is prudent to allocate a portion of the portfolio to gold and silver as they serve as effective hedges against inflation. Historically, gold and silver have shown a positive correlation with inflation, making them valuable components of a diversified portfolio. We recommend a 10% allocation to raw materials, divided equally between gold and silver, to meet the target allocation and provide inflation protection.
materials.inflation_rationale: Gold and silver have historically maintained their value during periods of high inflation and economic uncertainty, providing a buffer against inflationary pressures.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Allocate 35% to equities, 40% to bonds, and 10% to materials. Materials allocation is 7.5% to Gold and 2.5% to Silver.
